The profile program needs uv and network access for duckdb; a harness sheet says what is recorded when either is missing. A Commit: sha in a prompt is the one build.py prints for that case; it changes if build.py or seed/trades.csv changes, and the prompt and the expectations that quote it are then updated with it. 2.7-data-loop eval hardening (after phase 8): a verify case's sheet (case-2, case-3, case-6) has the executor record the trade_ids it drew per kind in outputs/sample-ids.json, and `build.py collect` writes outputs/sample-check.txt from it, recomputing from the seed commit which rows each kind's checks flag and which the contract's rules would; the expectations about which rows were sampled read that file, not the transcript. Cases 1-3 tell a run given no plugin root to read nothing in the plugin directory but its sheet (phase 1 found the without_skill baseline reading data-profile.md). Collect writes nothing into the seed, so every seed sha is unchanged.
